create_hypervolume_pareto_optimizer: create a HypervolumePareto instance with upper bounds to optimize multiobjective problems using hypervolume
add_parameter_to_pareto_front: add a nevergrad Parameter with multiobjective losses to the HypervolumePareto front and get its loss value
extend_pareto_front_with_batch: extend the HypervolumePareto front by adding a sequence of Parameters in a single call
get_pareto_front_subset: get a filtered subset of the Pareto front using random, EPS, or hypervolume selection strategies
filter_pareto_front_dominated: filter the ParetoFront to remove dominated points and keep only efficient non-dominated solutions
